explanation: Explication détaillée : 'Livre' est masculin singulier. Pour la deuxième personne du singulier, on emploie 'le tien'.

topic: Conjugaison
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Conjugaison Section 85
stem: Question 85 : Complétez la phrase au passé composé: 'Hier, les élèves _____ à l'école à pied.'
explanation: Explication détaillée : Le verbe 'aller' se conjugue avec l'auxiliaire être et le participe passé s'accorde avec le sujet pluriel: 'sont allés'.

topic: Grammaire
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Grammaire Section 86
stem: Question 86 : Trouvez l'adjectif démonstratif approprié: 'Regarde _____ bel arbre dans la cour.'
explanation: Explication détaillée : Devant un nom masculin singulier commençant par une voyelle ou un 'h' muet, on utilise 'cet'.

topic: Orthographe
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Orthographe Section 87
stem: Question 87 : Quel est le pluriel du mot 'le journal'?
explanation: Explication détaillée : Les noms terminés par '-al' forment généralement leur pluriel en '-aux'.

topic: Grammaire
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Grammaire Section 88
stem: Question 88 : Choisissez la préposition correcte: 'Mon oncle habite _____ Accra, au Ghana.'
explanation: Explication détaillée : Devant les noms de villes, on utilise la préposition 'à'.

topic: Conjugaison
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Conjugaison Section 89
stem: Question 89 : Mettez la phrase au futur simple: 'Demain, je _____ mes devoirs.'
explanation: Explication détaillée : Le verbe 'faire' à la première personne du singulier au futur simple est 'ferai'.

topic: Grammaire
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Grammaire Section 90
stem: Question 90 : Choisissez l'adverbe correspondant à l'adjectif 'rapide':
explanation: Explication détaillée : L'adverbe de manière régulier se forme en ajoutant le suffixe '-ment' au féminin de l'adjectif: 'rapidement'.

topic: Vocabulaire
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Vocabulaire Section 91
stem: Question 91 : Que signifie l'expression 'Il pleut des cordes'?
options: Il n'y a pas de pluie.
Il y a un vent léger.
explanation: Explication détaillée : L'expression idiomatique 'pleuvoir des cordes' signifie qu'il pleut abondamment.

topic: Communication
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Communication Section 92
stem: Question 92 : Pour saluer respectueusement quelqu'un le soir, on dit:
explanation: Explication détaillée : 'Bonsoir' est la salutation standard polie utilisée en fin d'après-midi et en soirée.

topic: Communication
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Communication Section 93
stem: Question 93 : Quelle formule utilise-t-on pour demander le prix d'un article au marché?
explanation: Explication détaillée : 'Combien ça coûte ?' est la tournure interrogative habituelle pour demander le prix.

topic: Vocabulaire
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Vocabulaire Section 94
stem: Question 94 : Quel est le contraire (antonyme) du mot 'généreux'?
explanation: Explication détaillée : 'Avare' (ou égoïste) est l'antonyme direct de généreux.

topic: Vocabulaire
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Vocabulaire Section 95
stem: Question 95 : La personne qui enseigne les mathématiques aux élèves s'appelle un:
explanation: Explication détaillée : Un professeur (ou enseignant) est la personne qualifiée pour instruire les élèves.

topic: Vocabulaire
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Vocabulaire Section 96
stem: Question 96 : Quel mot désigne le fils de votre frère ou de votre sœur?
explanation: Explication détaillée : Le neveu est le fils d'un frère ou d'une sœur.

topic: Vocabulaire
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Vocabulaire Section 97
stem: Question 97 : Trouvez le synonyme du mot 'difficile':
explanation: Explication détaillée : 'Compliqué' est synonyme de difficile, exigeant beaucoup d'effort ou de réflexion.

topic: Vocabulaire
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Vocabulaire Section 98
stem: Question 98 : Dans quelle pièce de la maison prépare-t-on généralement les repas?
explanation: Explication détaillée : La cuisine est la pièce réservée à la préparation de la nourriture.

topic: Communication
syllabusRef: NaCCA French Curriculum - Communication Section 99
stem: Question 99 : Pour exprimer un remerciement sincère, on dit:
explanation: Explication détaillée : 'Merci beaucoup' exprime la reconnaissance et la gratitude.

topic: Communication

stem: Question 100 : Quelle heure est-il si l'horloge indique 14h30?

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara

topic: Kasa Mmara

explanation: 'Nanso' ka kasamu mmienu a ɛne wɔn ho bɔ abira bom.

topic: Kasa Mmara

topic: Kasa Mmara

topic: Amammerɛ

stem: Akanfoɔ mu no, abofra a yɛwo no Yawoada no kradin de sɛn?
explanation: Ɔbarima a yɛwo no Yawoada no kradin ne Yaw, ɔbaa nso ne Yaa.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Akanfoɔ mu no, abofra a yɛwo no Fiada a ɔyɛ ɔbaa kradin ne hwan?
explanation: Fiada baa kradin ne Afia (Afua).

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Dɛn na Akanfoɔ de gye abofra foforɔ a yɛawo no to fie (Abadintoɔ)?
explanation: Yɛde nsuo ne nsa ka abofra no tɛkrɛma so kyerɛ nokorɛdie wɔ n'asetena mu.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Akanfoɔ mu no, abusuakuo dodoɔ a yɛwɔ yɛ ahe?
explanation: Akanfoɔ abusuakuo titire yɛ nson (Asona, Bretuo, Oyoko, Aduana, Ɛkoɔna, Asakyiri, Asenee).

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Abusuakuo bɛn na wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Ɔkɔdeɛ?
explanation: Oyoko abusuakuo ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Ɔkɔdeɛ.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Asonafoɔ ahyɛnsodeɛ titire ne deɛ bɛn?

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Berɛ a ɔpanyin bi wuo wɔ Akanman mu no, dɛn na wɔyɛ de kyerɛ obu ma n'asɛm?
explanation: Ayiyɛ ne amanneɛ a yɛde gya onipa kwan kɔ asaman.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Amanneɛ a yɛyɛ de gye abaayewa a waduru mpaninfeɛ to fekuo mu frɛ sɛn?
explanation: Bragoro ne amanneɛ a Akanfoɔ yɛ ma abaayewa a wanoa nufuo anaa wabu nsa.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Asanteman Afahyɛ kɛseɛ a wɔdi de kae wɔn nananom ne sɛn?

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Akyemfoɔ afahyɛ titire a wɔdi afe biara ne sɛn?
explanation: Odwira afahyɛ na Akuapemfoɔ ne Akyemfoɔ di.

topic: Agyarekɔ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Agyarekɔ
stem: Agya rekɔ kurotia na ɔresrɛ aduane; ɔbaa fie a ɔnkasa. Ɛyɛ deɛ bɛn? (Agyarekɔ)
explanation: Akokɔ a ɔwɔ nkesua so te sɛ ɔresrɛ aduane nanso ɔnkasa.

topic: Agyarekɔ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Agyarekɔ
stem: Agya rekɔ, me nso merekɔ; obiara ntwitwa obi akyi. Ɛyɛ deɛ bɛn?
explanation: Sunsuma di onipa akyi berɛ biara nanso obiara ntwitwa obi akyi.

topic: Agyarekɔ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Agyarekɔ
stem: Agya adeɛ bi wɔ hɔ, sɛ woto no tuo a, ɔnsuro; nanso wode wensu kyerɛ no a, ɔsuro. Ɛyɛ deɛ bɛn?
explanation: Amu (anaa ogya) nsuro tuo nanso nsuo bɛtumi adum no.

topic: Kasadwini

topic: Kasakoa

syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasakoa

topic: Kasakoa

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasakoa

explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Fefeɛ' kyerɛ sɛnea ɔbaa no ahosuo anaa ne ho teɛ.

topic: Kasa Mmara

stem: Asɛmmisa 57: Asɛmfua bɛn na ɛyɛ kasamafoɔ (Adverb) wɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Kwame tuu mmirika ntɛmntɛm.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Ntɛmntɛm' kyerɛ sɛnea Kwame faa so tuu mmirika no.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 58
stem: Asɛmmisa 58: Kyerɛ nkabomdeɛ (Conjunction) a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Mepɛ sɛ mekɔ sukuu nanso minsuro nsuo.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Nanso' ka kasamu mmienu a ɛne wɔn ho bɔ abira bom.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 59
stem: Asɛmmisa 59: Asin (Morpheme) a yɛde hyɛ asɛmfua anim de dane ne tebea frɛ dɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Animdeɛ (Prefix) na ɛba asɛmfua anim.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 60
stem: Asɛmmisa 60: Nsɛmfua ahodoɔ mmienu yi: 'kɛseɛ' ne 'ketewa' kyerɛ dɛn?
options: Nsɛmfua a ɛne wɔn ho sɛ
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Nsɛmfua a ɛbɔ abira (Antonyms) na kɛseɛ ne ketewa yɛ.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Amammerɛ Asɛmti 61
stem: Asɛmmisa 61: Akanfoɔ mu no, abofra a yɛwo no Yawoada no kradin de sɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɔbarima a yɛwo no Yawoada no kradin ne Yaw, ɔbaa nso ne Yaa.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Amammerɛ Asɛmti 62
stem: Asɛmmisa 62: Akanfoɔ mu no, abofra a yɛwo no Fiada a ɔyɛ ɔbaa kradin ne hwan?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Fiada baa kradin ne Afia (Afua).

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Amammerɛ Asɛmti 63
stem: Asɛmmisa 63: Dɛn na Akanfoɔ de gye abofra foforɔ a yɛawo no to fie (Abadintoɔ)?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Yɛde nsuo ne nsa ka abofra no tɛkrɛma so kyerɛ nokorɛdie wɔ n'asetena mu.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Amammerɛ Asɛmti 64
stem: Asɛmmisa 64: Akanfoɔ mu no, abusuakuo dodoɔ a yɛwɔ yɛ ahe?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Akanfoɔ abusuakuo titire yɛ nson (Asona, Bretuo, Oyoko, Aduana, Ɛkoɔna, Asakyiri, Asenee).

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Amammerɛ Asɛmti 65
stem: Asɛmmisa 65: Abusuakuo bɛn na wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Ɔkɔdeɛ?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Oyoko abusuakuo ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Ɔkɔdeɛ.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Amammerɛ Asɛmti 66
stem: Asɛmmisa 66: Asonafoɔ ahyɛnsodeɛ titire ne deɛ bɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Asonafoɔ agyiraehyɛdeɛ ne Anene (Kwaakwaadabi).

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Amammerɛ Asɛmti 67
stem: Asɛmmisa 67: Berɛ a ɔpanyin bi wuo wɔ Akanman mu no, dɛn na wɔyɛ de kyerɛ obu ma n'asɛm?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ayiyɛ ne amanneɛ a yɛde gya onipa kwan kɔ asaman.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Amammerɛ Asɛmti 68
stem: Asɛmmisa 68: Amanneɛ a yɛyɛ de gye abaayewa a waduru mpaninfeɛ to fekuo mu frɛ sɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Bragoro ne amanneɛ a Akanfoɔ yɛ ma abaayewa a wanoa nufuo anaa wabu nsa.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Amammerɛ Asɛmti 69
stem: Asɛmmisa 69: Asanteman Afahyɛ kɛseɛ a wɔdi de kae wɔn nananom ne sɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Akwasidae (ne Awukudae) ne Adae afahyɛ a Asanteman di.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Amammerɛ Asɛmti 70
stem: Asɛmmisa 70: Akyemfoɔ afahyɛ titire a wɔdi afe biara ne sɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Odwira afahyɛ na Akuapemfoɔ ne Akyemfoɔ di.

topic: Agyarekɔ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Agyarekɔ Asɛmti 71
stem: Asɛmmisa 71: Agya rekɔ kurotia na ɔresrɛ aduane; ɔbaa fie a ɔnkasa. Ɛyɛ deɛ bɛn? (Agyarekɔ)
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Akokɔ a ɔwɔ nkesua so te sɛ ɔresrɛ aduane nanso ɔnkasa.

topic: Agyarekɔ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Agyarekɔ Asɛmti 72
stem: Asɛmmisa 72: Agya rekɔ, me nso merekɔ; obiara ntwitwa obi akyi. Ɛyɛ deɛ bɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Sunsuma di onipa akyi berɛ biara nanso obiara ntwitwa obi akyi.

topic: Agyarekɔ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Agyarekɔ Asɛmti 73
stem: Asɛmmisa 73: Agya adeɛ bi wɔ hɔ, sɛ woto no tuo a, ɔnsuro; nanso wode wensu kyerɛ no a, ɔsuro. Ɛyɛ deɛ bɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Amu (anaa ogya) nsuro tuo nanso nsuo bɛtumi adum no.

topic: Kasadwini
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasadwini Asɛmti 74
stem: Asɛmmisa 74: Dɛn na Akan panyin gyina so ka kasa mu nsɛm de hyɛ abarimaa nkuran?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Abebusem ma kasa yɛ dɛ na ɛhyɛ onipa nkuran.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasakoa Asɛmti 75
stem: Asɛmmisa 75: Kasakoa: Sɛ yɛka sɛ 'Ɔbaa no kɔ akyire' a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Ɔkɔ akyire' yɛ kasakoa a Akanfoɔ de kyerɛ sɛ ɔbaa bi anyinsɛn.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasakoa Asɛmti 76
stem: Asɛmmisa 76: Kasakoa: Sɛ yɛka sɛ 'Ɔhene no kɔ n'akuraa' a, ɛkyerɛ dɛn koraa?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Wɔmfa nnaano nka sɛ ɔhene bi awuo; yɛka sɛ wakɔ n'akuraa anaa wadum.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasakoa Asɛmti 77
stem: Asɛmmisa 77: Kasakoa: 'Ɔwɔ nsa tintin' kyerɛ sɛn wɔ Akan asetena mu?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Nsa tenten' kyerɛ onipa a ɔyɛ korɔmfoɔ anaa owia adeɛ.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasakoa Asɛmti 78
stem: Asɛmmisa 78: Kasakoa: 'Ne nan mu yɛ duru' kyerɛ sɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Ne nan mu yɛ duru' yɛ kasakoa a ɛkyerɛ nyinsɛn.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasakoa Asɛmti 79
stem: Asɛmmisa 79: Kasakoa: 'Ɔte n'aso mu' kyerɛ dɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Ɔte n'aso mu' kyerɛ onipa a ɔyɛ asoɔden na ɔntie afutuo.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasakoa Asɛmti 80
stem: Asɛmmisa 80: Kasakoa: 'Ne nsa da ne mu' kyerɛ sɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Ne nsa da ne mu' kyerɛ onipa a ɔyɛ yamfoɔ a ɔmpepe adeɛ.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 81
stem: Asɛmmisa 81: Toa bɛ yi so: 'Tikro nko...', nkyerɛase koraa ne sɛ:
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Tikro nko agyina. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ adwene baako nso nnipa baako nko ara ntumi nsi gyinae pa.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 82
stem: Asɛmmisa 82: Kyerɛ bɛ yi ase: 'Woforo dua pa a...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Woforo dua pa a, na yepia wo. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ sɛ woyɛ adepa a, obiara botae ne sɛ ɔbɛboa wo.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 83
stem: Asɛmmisa 83: Sɛ obi ka sɛ 'Abofra bɔ nwa na ɔmmɔ akyekyedeɛ' a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ:
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ obiara yɛ nea ne nteaseɛ anaa n'ahoɔden bɛtumi aduru.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 84
stem: Asɛmmisa 84: Bɛ 'Baako werɛ aduru a, ɛdan gu' kyerɛ sɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ nkabom ne baakoyɛ na ɛma adwuma biara tu mpɔn.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 85
stem: Asɛmmisa 85: Bɛ 'Sɛ panyin te fie na nkwadaa we ntɛtea a...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Sɛ panyin te fie na nkwadaa we ntɛtea a, yɛka sɛ ɔno na wama kwan anaa ɔno ara na we bi.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 86
stem: Asɛmmisa 86: Kyerɛ bɛ yi so: 'Nsateaa nnum no...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Nsateaa nnum no nyinaa nyɛ pɛ. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ nnipa nteaseɛ ne wɔn suban nyɛ pɛ.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 87
stem: Asɛmmisa 87: Kyerɛ 'Akokɔ nan tia ne ba so nanso...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Akokɔ nan tia ne ba so a, ɛnkum no. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ awofoɔ nteɛsoɔ nkyerɛ sɛ wɔtan wɔn mma.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 88
stem: Asɛmmisa 88: Sɛ Akanfoɔ ka sɛ 'Obi mfa ne nsa nni na ɔmfa nsa baako nwe mako' a, ɛkyerɛ dɛn?
options: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ biribi a ɛbɛgu yɛn anim ase
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ obi gu n'ankasa anim ase.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 89
stem: Asɛmmisa 89: Bɛ 'Obi nkyerɛ abofra Nyame' kyerɛ dɛn?
options: Nyame kɛseyɛ da adi pefee ma obiara hu
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ Nyame tumi ne ne kɛseyɛ da adi ma obiara, abofra mpo nim.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 90
stem: Asɛmmisa 90: Bɛ 'Akoma te sɛ bɔtɔ...', kyerɛ nea ɛkɔ so:
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Akoma te sɛ bɔtɔ, obi nhunumu. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi ntumi nhu nea ɔfoforɔ dwene wɔ n'akoma mu.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 91

explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Kofi' ne 'Kumase' yɛ edin pɔtee (proper noun).

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 92
stem: Asɛmmisa 92: Edin nsiantumi (Pronoun) bɛn na ɛhyɛ 'Ama' ananmu wɔ kasamu yi mu? 'Ama kɔɔ sukuu.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Ɔno' (ɔ-) ne edin nsiantumi a ɛfata obiako pɔtee a ɔnyɛ wo anaa me.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Mmɛ
stem: Toa bɛ yi so: 'Tikro nko...', nkyerɛase koraa ne sɛ:
explanation: Tikro nko agyina. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ adwene baako nso nnipa baako nko ara ntumi nsi gyinae pa.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Mmɛ
stem: Kyerɛ bɛ yi ase: 'Woforo dua pa a...'
explanation: Woforo dua pa a, na yepia wo. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ sɛ woyɛ adepa a, obiara botae ne sɛ ɔbɛboa wo.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Mmɛ
stem: Sɛ obi ka sɛ 'Abofra bɔ nwa na ɔmmɔ akyekyedeɛ' a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ:
explanation: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ obiara yɛ nea ne nteaseɛ anaa n'ahoɔden bɛtumi aduru.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Mmɛ
stem: Bɛ 'Baako werɛ aduru a, ɛdan gu' kyerɛ sɛn?
explanation: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ nkabom ne baakoyɛ na ɛma adwuma biara tu mpɔn.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Mmɛ
stem: Bɛ 'Sɛ panyin te fie na nkwadaa we ntɛtea a...'
explanation: Sɛ panyin te fie na nkwadaa we ntɛtea a, yɛka sɛ ɔno na wama kwan anaa ɔno ara na we bi.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Mmɛ
stem: Kyerɛ bɛ yi so: 'Nsateaa nnum no...'
explanation: Nsateaa nnum no nyinaa nyɛ pɛ. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ nnipa nteaseɛ ne wɔn suban nyɛ pɛ.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Mmɛ
stem: Kyerɛ 'Akokɔ nan tia ne ba so nanso...'
explanation: Akokɔ nan tia ne ba so a, ɛnkum no. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ awofoɔ nteɛsoɔ nkyerɛ sɛ wɔtan wɔn mma.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Mmɛ
stem: Sɛ Akanfoɔ ka sɛ 'Obi mfa ne nsa nni na ɔmfa nsa baako nwe mako' a, ɛkyerɛ dɛn?
options: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ biribi a ɛbɛgu yɛn anim ase
explanation: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ obi gu n'ankasa anim ase.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Mmɛ
stem: Bɛ 'Obi nkyerɛ abofra Nyame' kyerɛ dɛn?
options: Nyame kɛseyɛ da adi pefee ma obiara hu
explanation: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ Nyame tumi ne ne kɛseyɛ da adi ma obiara, abofra mpo nim.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Mmɛ
stem: Bɛ 'Akoma te sɛ bɔtɔ...', kyerɛ nea ɛkɔ so:
explanation: Akoma te sɛ bɔtɔ, obi nhunumu. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi ntumi nhu nea ɔfoforɔ dwene wɔ n'akoma mu.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara
stem: Kyerɛ Edin kɛseɛ (Proper Noun) a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Kofi kɔɔ Kumase nnɛ anɔpa.'
explanation: 'Kofi' ne 'Kumase' yɛ edin pɔtee (proper noun).

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara
stem: Edin nsiantumi (Pronoun) bɛn na ɛhyɛ 'Ama' ananmu wɔ kasamu yi mu? 'Ama kɔɔ sukuu.'
explanation: 'Ɔno' (ɔ-) ne edin nsiantumi a ɛfata obiako pɔtee a ɔnyɛ wo anaa me.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara
stem: Kyerɛ Adeyɔ (Verb) a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Abofra no redidi anigyeɛ so.'
explanation: 'Redidi' kyerɛ adeyɔ a ɛrekɔ so mprempren.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara
stem: Adekyerɛ (Adjective) adwuma titire ne sɛ:
explanation: Adekyerɛ kyerɛ suban anaa tebea a edin bi wom.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara
stem: Kyerɛ adekyerɛ a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Ɔbaa fefeɛ no baa fie ha.'
explanation: 'Fefeɛ' kyerɛ sɛnea ɔbaa no ahosuo anaa ne ho teɛ.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara
stem: Kyerɛ kasamu tebea yi: 'Yɛnkɔ fie!'
explanation: Kasamu a ɛhyɛ anaa ɛsrɛ adeyɔ bi yɛ Ahyɛdeɛ kasamu (Imperative sentence).

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara
stem: Asɛmfua bɛn na ɛyɛ kasamafoɔ (Adverb) wɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Kwame tuu mmirika ntɛmntɛm.'
explanation: 'Ntɛmntɛm' kyerɛ sɛnea Kwame faa so tuu mmirika no.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara
stem: Kyerɛ nkabomdeɛ (Conjunction) a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Mepɛ sɛ mekɔ sukuu nanso minsuro nsuo.'
explanation: 'Nanso' ka kasamu mmienu a ɛne wɔn ho bɔ abira bom.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara
stem: Asin (Morpheme) a yɛde hyɛ asɛmfua anim de dane ne tebea frɛ dɛn?
explanation: Animdeɛ (Prefix) na ɛba asɛmfua anim.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasa Mmara

stem: Akanfoɔ mu no, abofra a yɛwo no Fiada a ɔyɛ ɔbaa kradin ne hwan?

stem: Akanfoɔ mu no, abusuakuo dodoɔ a yɛwɔ yɛ ahe?

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Abusuakuo bɛn na wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Ɔkɔdeɛ?
explanation: Oyoko abusuakuo ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Ɔkɔdeɛ.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Asonafoɔ ahyɛnsodeɛ titire ne deɛ bɛn?
explanation: Asonafoɔ agyiraehyɛdeɛ ne Anene (Kwaakwaadabi).

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Berɛ a ɔpanyin bi wuo wɔ Akanman mu no, dɛn na wɔyɛ de kyerɛ obu ma n'asɛm?
explanation: Ayiyɛ ne amanneɛ a yɛde gya onipa kwan kɔ asaman.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Amanneɛ a yɛyɛ de gye abaayewa a waduru mpaninfeɛ to fekuo mu frɛ sɛn?
explanation: Bragoro ne amanneɛ a Akanfoɔ yɛ ma abaayewa a wanoa nufuo anaa wabu nsa.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Asanteman Afahyɛ kɛseɛ a wɔdi de kae wɔn nananom ne sɛn?
explanation: Akwasidae (ne Awukudae) ne Adae afahyɛ a Asanteman di.

topic: Amammerɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Amammerɛ
stem: Akyemfoɔ afahyɛ titire a wɔdi afe biara ne sɛn?
explanation: Odwira afahyɛ na Akuapemfoɔ ne Akyemfoɔ di.

topic: Agyarekɔ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Agyarekɔ
stem: Agya rekɔ kurotia na ɔresrɛ aduane; ɔbaa fie a ɔnkasa. Ɛyɛ deɛ bɛn? (Agyarekɔ)
explanation: Akokɔ a ɔwɔ nkesua so te sɛ ɔresrɛ aduane nanso ɔnkasa.

topic: Agyarekɔ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Agyarekɔ
stem: Agya rekɔ, me nso merekɔ; obiara ntwitwa obi akyi. Ɛyɛ deɛ bɛn?
explanation: Sunsuma di onipa akyi berɛ biara nanso obiara ntwitwa obi akyi.

topic: Agyarekɔ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Agyarekɔ
stem: Agya adeɛ bi wɔ hɔ, sɛ woto no tuo a, ɔnsuro; nanso wode wensu kyerɛ no a, ɔsuro. Ɛyɛ deɛ bɛn?
explanation: Amu (anaa ogya) nsuro tuo nanso nsuo bɛtumi adum no.

topic: Kasadwini
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasadwini
stem: Dɛn na Akan panyin gyina so ka kasa mu nsɛm de hyɛ abarimaa nkuran?
explanation: Abebusem ma kasa yɛ dɛ na ɛhyɛ onipa nkuran.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasakoa
stem: Kasakoa: Sɛ yɛka sɛ 'Ɔbaa no kɔ akyire' a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛn?
explanation: 'Ɔkɔ akyire' yɛ kasakoa a Akanfoɔ de kyerɛ sɛ ɔbaa bi anyinsɛn.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasakoa
stem: Kasakoa: Sɛ yɛka sɛ 'Ɔhene no kɔ n'akuraa' a, ɛkyerɛ dɛn koraa?
explanation: Wɔmfa nnaano nka sɛ ɔhene bi awuo; yɛka sɛ wakɔ n'akuraa anaa wadum.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasakoa
stem: Kasakoa: 'Ɔwɔ nsa tintin' kyerɛ sɛn wɔ Akan asetena mu?
explanation: 'Nsa tenten' kyerɛ onipa a ɔyɛ korɔmfoɔ anaa owia adeɛ.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasakoa
stem: Kasakoa: 'Ne nan mu yɛ duru' kyerɛ sɛn?
explanation: 'Ne nan mu yɛ duru' yɛ kasakoa a ɛkyerɛ nyinsɛn.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasakoa
stem: Kasakoa: 'Ɔte n'aso mu' kyerɛ dɛn?
explanation: 'Ɔte n'aso mu' kyerɛ onipa a ɔyɛ asoɔden na ɔntie afutuo.

topic: Kasakoa
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi / Ghanaian Language Syllabus - Kasakoa
stem: Kasakoa: 'Ne nsa da ne mu' kyerɛ sɛn?
explanation: 'Ne nsa da ne mu' kyerɛ onipa a ɔyɛ yamfoɔ a ɔmpepe adeɛ.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 41
stem: Asɛmmisa 41: Toa bɛ yi so: 'Tikro nko...', nkyerɛase koraa ne sɛ:
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Tikro nko agyina. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ adwene baako nso nnipa baako nko ara ntumi nsi gyinae pa.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 42
stem: Asɛmmisa 42: Kyerɛ bɛ yi ase: 'Woforo dua pa a...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Woforo dua pa a, na yepia wo. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ sɛ woyɛ adepa a, obiara botae ne sɛ ɔbɛboa wo.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 43
stem: Asɛmmisa 43: Sɛ obi ka sɛ 'Abofra bɔ nwa na ɔmmɔ akyekyedeɛ' a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ:
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ obiara yɛ nea ne nteaseɛ anaa n'ahoɔden bɛtumi aduru.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 44
stem: Asɛmmisa 44: Bɛ 'Baako werɛ aduru a, ɛdan gu' kyerɛ sɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ nkabom ne baakoyɛ na ɛma adwuma biara tu mpɔn.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 45
stem: Asɛmmisa 45: Bɛ 'Sɛ panyin te fie na nkwadaa we ntɛtea a...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Sɛ panyin te fie na nkwadaa we ntɛtea a, yɛka sɛ ɔno na wama kwan anaa ɔno ara na we bi.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 46
stem: Asɛmmisa 46: Kyerɛ bɛ yi so: 'Nsateaa nnum no...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Nsateaa nnum no nyinaa nyɛ pɛ. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ nnipa nteaseɛ ne wɔn suban nyɛ pɛ.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 47
stem: Asɛmmisa 47: Kyerɛ 'Akokɔ nan tia ne ba so nanso...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Akokɔ nan tia ne ba so a, ɛnkum no. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ awofoɔ nteɛsoɔ nkyerɛ sɛ wɔtan wɔn mma.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 48
stem: Asɛmmisa 48: Sɛ Akanfoɔ ka sɛ 'Obi mfa ne nsa nni na ɔmfa nsa baako nwe mako' a, ɛkyerɛ dɛn?
options: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ biribi a ɛbɛgu yɛn anim ase
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ obi gu n'ankasa anim ase.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 49
stem: Asɛmmisa 49: Bɛ 'Obi nkyerɛ abofra Nyame' kyerɛ dɛn?
options: Nyame kɛseyɛ da adi pefee ma obiara hu
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ Nyame tumi ne ne kɛseyɛ da adi ma obiara, abofra mpo nim.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 50
stem: Asɛmmisa 50: Bɛ 'Akoma te sɛ bɔtɔ...', kyerɛ nea ɛkɔ so:
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Akoma te sɛ bɔtɔ, obi nhunumu. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi ntumi nhu nea ɔfoforɔ dwene wɔ n'akoma mu.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 51
stem: Asɛmmisa 51: Kyerɛ Edin kɛseɛ (Proper Noun) a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Kofi kɔɔ Kumase nnɛ anɔpa.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Kofi' ne 'Kumase' yɛ edin pɔtee (proper noun).

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 52
stem: Asɛmmisa 52: Edin nsiantumi (Pronoun) bɛn na ɛhyɛ 'Ama' ananmu wɔ kasamu yi mu? 'Ama kɔɔ sukuu.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Ɔno' (ɔ-) ne edin nsiantumi a ɛfata obiako pɔtee a ɔnyɛ wo anaa me.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 53
stem: Asɛmmisa 53: Kyerɛ Adeyɔ (Verb) a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Abofra no redidi anigyeɛ so.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Redidi' kyerɛ adeyɔ a ɛrekɔ so mprempren.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 54
stem: Asɛmmisa 54: Adekyerɛ (Adjective) adwuma titire ne sɛ:
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Adekyerɛ kyerɛ suban anaa tebea a edin bi wom.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 55
stem: Asɛmmisa 55: Kyerɛ adekyerɛ a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Ɔbaa fefeɛ no baa fie ha.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Fefeɛ' kyerɛ sɛnea ɔbaa no ahosuo anaa ne ho teɛ.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 56
stem: Asɛmmisa 56: Kyerɛ kasamu tebea yi: 'Yɛnkɔ fie!'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Kasamu a ɛhyɛ anaa ɛsrɛ adeyɔ bi yɛ Ahyɛdeɛ kasamu (Imperative sentence).

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 57
stem: Asɛmmisa 57: Asɛmfua bɛn na ɛyɛ kasamafoɔ (Adverb) wɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Kwame tuu mmirika ntɛmntɛm.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Ntɛmntɛm' kyerɛ sɛnea Kwame faa so tuu mmirika no.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 58
stem: Asɛmmisa 58: Kyerɛ nkabomdeɛ (Conjunction) a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Mepɛ sɛ mekɔ sukuu nanso minsuro nsuo.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Nanso' ka kasamu mmienu a ɛne wɔn ho bɔ abira bom.

syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 59

explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Animdeɛ (Prefix) na ɛba asɛmfua anim.

explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ obiara yɛ nea ne nteaseɛ anaa n'ahoɔden bɛtumi aduru.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 84
stem: Asɛmmisa 84: Bɛ 'Baako werɛ aduru a, ɛdan gu' kyerɛ sɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ nkabom ne baakoyɛ na ɛma adwuma biara tu mpɔn.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 85
stem: Asɛmmisa 85: Bɛ 'Sɛ panyin te fie na nkwadaa we ntɛtea a...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Sɛ panyin te fie na nkwadaa we ntɛtea a, yɛka sɛ ɔno na wama kwan anaa ɔno ara na we bi.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 86
stem: Asɛmmisa 86: Kyerɛ bɛ yi so: 'Nsateaa nnum no...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Nsateaa nnum no nyinaa nyɛ pɛ. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ nnipa nteaseɛ ne wɔn suban nyɛ pɛ.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 87
stem: Asɛmmisa 87: Kyerɛ 'Akokɔ nan tia ne ba so nanso...'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Akokɔ nan tia ne ba so a, ɛnkum no. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ awofoɔ nteɛsoɔ nkyerɛ sɛ wɔtan wɔn mma.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 88
stem: Asɛmmisa 88: Sɛ Akanfoɔ ka sɛ 'Obi mfa ne nsa nni na ɔmfa nsa baako nwe mako' a, ɛkyerɛ dɛn?
options: Ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ biribi a ɛbɛgu yɛn anim ase
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ obi gu n'ankasa anim ase.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 89
stem: Asɛmmisa 89: Bɛ 'Obi nkyerɛ abofra Nyame' kyerɛ dɛn?
options: Nyame kɛseyɛ da adi pefee ma obiara hu
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ Nyame tumi ne ne kɛseyɛ da adi ma obiara, abofra mpo nim.

topic: Mmɛ
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Mmɛ Asɛmti 90
stem: Asɛmmisa 90: Bɛ 'Akoma te sɛ bɔtɔ...', kyerɛ nea ɛkɔ so:
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Akoma te sɛ bɔtɔ, obi nhunumu. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi ntumi nhu nea ɔfoforɔ dwene wɔ n'akoma mu.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 91
stem: Asɛmmisa 91: Kyerɛ Edin kɛseɛ (Proper Noun) a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Kofi kɔɔ Kumase nnɛ anɔpa.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Kofi' ne 'Kumase' yɛ edin pɔtee (proper noun).

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 92
stem: Asɛmmisa 92: Edin nsiantumi (Pronoun) bɛn na ɛhyɛ 'Ama' ananmu wɔ kasamu yi mu? 'Ama kɔɔ sukuu.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Ɔno' (ɔ-) ne edin nsiantumi a ɛfata obiako pɔtee a ɔnyɛ wo anaa me.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 93
stem: Asɛmmisa 93: Kyerɛ Adeyɔ (Verb) a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Abofra no redidi anigyeɛ so.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Redidi' kyerɛ adeyɔ a ɛrekɔ so mprempren.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 94
stem: Asɛmmisa 94: Adekyerɛ (Adjective) adwuma titire ne sɛ:
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Adekyerɛ kyerɛ suban anaa tebea a edin bi wom.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 95
stem: Asɛmmisa 95: Kyerɛ adekyerɛ a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Ɔbaa fefeɛ no baa fie ha.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Fefeɛ' kyerɛ sɛnea ɔbaa no ahosuo anaa ne ho teɛ.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 96
stem: Asɛmmisa 96: Kyerɛ kasamu tebea yi: 'Yɛnkɔ fie!'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Kasamu a ɛhyɛ anaa ɛsrɛ adeyɔ bi yɛ Ahyɛdeɛ kasamu (Imperative sentence).

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 97
stem: Asɛmmisa 97: Asɛmfua bɛn na ɛyɛ kasamafoɔ (Adverb) wɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Kwame tuu mmirika ntɛmntɛm.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Ntɛmntɛm' kyerɛ sɛnea Kwame faa so tuu mmirika no.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 98
stem: Asɛmmisa 98: Kyerɛ nkabomdeɛ (Conjunction) a ɛwɔ kasamu yi mu: 'Mepɛ sɛ mekɔ sukuu nanso minsuro nsuo.'
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: 'Nanso' ka kasamu mmienu a ɛne wɔn ho bɔ abira bom.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 99
stem: Asɛmmisa 99: Asin (Morpheme) a yɛde hyɛ asɛmfua anim de dane ne tebea frɛ dɛn?
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Animdeɛ (Prefix) na ɛba asɛmfua anim.

topic: Kasa Mmara
syllabusRef: NaCCA Twi Syllabus - Kasa Mmara Asɛmti 100
stem: Asɛmmisa 100: Nsɛmfua ahodoɔ mmienu yi: 'kɛseɛ' ne 'ketewa' kyerɛ dɛn?
options: Nsɛmfua a ɛne wɔn ho sɛ
explanation: Nkyerɛkyerɛmu: Nsɛmfua a ɛbɔ abira (Antonyms) na kɛseɛ ne ketewa yɛ.
